summary: Learn to define customer segments, prioritize target groups and connect CRM insights to campaign decisions. Explore the five-day foundation course.
lede: Customer segmentation groups customers by shared needs, behaviours or value, helping marketing, sales and customer-insight professionals choose campaign audiences. You practise applying STP and RFM, checking whether CRM fields support usable segments, and comparing groups to prioritize targets. The course also covers matching messages to customer needs, handing audience definitions between teams and selecting campaign measures; predictive segmentation is introduced at overview level.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who use customer or account information to plan campaigns, assign sales attention or improve audience selection.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with customer or account records and routine marketing or sales activity. No coding is required.
